fullPassage: Many opponents of animal experimentation argue that not only is modern medicine not the only cause for the decline in mortality, many medical advances that did contribute to human health were not the result of animal experimentation. Defenders of research have claimed that since there is a strong correlation between the practice of animal experimentation and medical advancement, the former caused the latter. Opponents of research reject this inference. After all, we have independent reasons to expect these phenomena to be correlated. Since the law prescribes that all new drugs, prosthetic devices, and surgical techniques be tried on animals before they are used in humans, we will subsequently find that all medical advances are correlated with prior experimentation on animals. Consequently, the correlation between animal experimentation and medical discovery is the result of legal necessity, not evidence that animal experimentation led to medical advances. Moreover, several influential physicians have offered historical evidence that animal experimentation has not been as responsible for biomedical discovery as defenders suggest. They claim that clinical discoveries played a more substantial role than animal researchers have led us to believe.

❌ ④ recognize(인식하다) — 인지를 나타내는 다른 의미축
det.tip: believe(믿다) ↔ doubt(의심하다). trust(신뢰)는 동의어 함정

questions.passage:
(A) Vitamins play an important role in maintaining good health. Doctors say a balanced diet helps this role work properly.

(B) The famous actor won an award for his role in the war film. He spent months preparing for the difficult role before shooting began.
questions.stem: 다음 (A)와 (B)에서 밑줄 친 role의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) role=역할(비타민이 건강 유지에 하는 역할), (B) role=배역(영화 속 배우의 배역)
det.analysis:
❌ ① 의미가 뒤바뀜 — (A)가 역할, (B)가 배역
✅ ② (A) 역할 — (B) 배역: (A)는 비타민의 '역할', (B)는 영화 속 '배역' ←정답
❌ ③ 기능/무대는 정확한 뜻이 아님
❌ ④ 임무/관객은 정확한 뜻이 아님
det.tip: role: 역할(function) / 배역(part in a film)

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
"a mutual relationship or connection between two or more things"

det.korean: 둘 이상의 것 사이의 상호 관계나 연관 → correlation(상관관계)
det.analysis:
❌ ① necessity(필요성) — 상호 관계가 아님
❌ ② mortality(사망률) — 상호 관계가 아님
✅ ③ correlation — '둘 이상 사이의 상호 관계/연관'에 정확히 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ inference(추론) — 근거로부터의 결론이지 상호 관계가 아님
det.tip: correlation = a mutual relationship between two or more things

questions.passage: Defenders of research have claimed that since there is a strong correlation between the practice of animal experimentation and medical advancement, the former __________ (cause) the latter.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: cause → caused: 과거 사실을 나타내는 문장에서 과거시제 필요
det.analysis: ✅ 정답: caused — 'the former _____(cause) the latter'에서 전자가 후자를 야기했다는 과거 사실이므로 과거형 caused 필요
det.tip: cause → caused (과거시제)

questions.passage: Since the law prescribes that all new drugs, prosthetic devices, and surgical techniques be __________ (try) on animals before they are used in humans, we will subsequently find that all medical advances are correlated with prior experimentation on animals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: try → tried: 'be + 과거분사' 수동태 구조에서 과거분사 필요
det.analysis: ✅ 정답: tried — 'techniques be _____(try) on animals'에서 be동사 뒤 수동태이므로 과거분사 tried 필요
det.tip: try → tried (be + 과거분사 = 수동태)

questions.passage: Many opponents of animal experimentation argue that not only is modern medicine not the only cause for the decline in mortality, many medical advances that did contribute to human health were not the result of animal experimentation. Defenders of research have claimed that since there is a strong correlation between the practice of animal experimentation and medical advancement, the former caused the latter. Opponents of research reject this inference. After all, we have independent reasons to expect these phenomena to be correlated. Since the law prescribes that all new drugs, prosthetic devices, and surgical techniques be tried on animals before they are used in humans, we will subsequently find that all medical advances are correlated with prior experimentation on animals. Consequently, the correlation between animal experimentation and medical discovery is __________, not evidence that animal experimentation led to medical advances. Moreover, several influential physicians have offered historical evidence that animal experimentation has not been as responsible for biomedical discovery as defenders suggest. They claim that clinical discoveries played a more substantial role than animal researchers have led us to believe.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 상관관계는 '법적 필요성의 결과(the result of legal necessity)'이지 인과의 증거가 아니라는 맥락
det.analysis:
❌ ① the cause of medical progress(의학 발전의 원인) — 반대자의 주장(인과 아님)과 모순
❌ ② a proof of animal suffering(동물 고통의 증거) — 지문 논지와 무관
❌ ③ a sign of scientific failure(과학 실패의 신호) — 지문에 없는 내용
✅ ④ the result of legal necessity — 원문 일치. 법이 동물실험을 의무화하기에 생긴 결과 ←정답
det.tip: the result of legal necessity, not evidence — 법적 필요성의 결과

questions.passage: Many opponents of animal experimentation argue that not only is modern medicine not the only cause for the decline in mortality, many medical advances that did contribute to human health were not the result of animal experimentation. Opponents of research reject this inference. After all, we have independent reasons to expect these phenomena to be correlated. Since the law prescribes that all new drugs, prosthetic devices, and surgical techniques be tried on animals before they are used in humans, we will subsequently find that all medical advances are correlated with prior experimentation on animals. Consequently, the correlation between animal experimentation and medical discovery is the result of legal necessity, not evidence that animal experimentation led to medical advances. Moreover, several influential physicians have offered historical evidence that animal experimentation has not been as responsible for biomedical discovery as defenders suggest. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 임상 발견이 동물 연구자들이 믿게 한 것보다 '더 상당한 역할을 했다'는 맥락
det.analysis:
✅ ① clinical discoveries played a more substantial role — 원문 일치. 임상 발견이 더 큰 역할을 했다는 의사들의 주장 ←정답
❌ ② animal experiments were the main source of progress(동물실험이 진보의 주원천) — 지문 논지와 정반대
❌ ③ modern medicine had no real impact(현대 의학이 영향 없다) — 지문에 없는 과장
❌ ④ legal necessity prevented advancement(법적 필요성이 진보를 막았다) — 지문과 무관
det.tip: clinical discoveries played a more substantial role — 임상 발견이 더 큰 역할
